OCRelay 1.1.17

LE ARTERIAL — TWO NUMBERS IN ONE VELOCITY BOX

• Some LE arterial worksheets write each artery as two numbers with a slash, such as 138.0/8.6. The higher of the two now goes into the review panel and the report — 138.0 in that example.

• Decimals are kept as written on the sheet.

• Waveforms are not affected, and nor is any other study.

• Applies to both bilateral and unilateral LE arterial.
